plan.notes: Official Gavilan College Program Pathways Mapper (gavilan.programmapper.com), site-content year 2025-2026; pathway “to Certificate - Fire Science – Certificate of Achievement”. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total credits (21.5) = sum of published pathway slots. Per-course prerequisites are not published in structured form on the mapper, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty; see the official catalog's course descriptions for official prerequisites. A prerequisite naming a course outside the published pathway would be listed in external_prereqs, never invented into a term.
